evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To further evaluate dependency-version compatibility, we introduce VersionExec, an execution-based benchmark derived from BigCodeBench that evaluates generation under different dependency versions.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Repository-level code generation requires generated code to be compatible not only with the target repository but also with its dependency environment.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experimental results on RepoExec, DevEval, and VersionExec demonstrate that CrossCoder consistently improves both functional correctness (up to 6.3% on pass@1) and robustness to dependency-version changes.
